Commentary.Commentary: ...Day 3, final session...

So let's see how the English batters reply now. They would look to wipe off the deficit first today and then build on the lead. The Pakistani bowlers would be raring to go once again. Join us back in a bit after the Tea break for England's reply.

Anderson looked the most threatening bowler for England but the pacer was taken off the attack as he ran on the danger area multiple times. He got two wickets while his partner Broad got three wickets. Chris Woakes' remarkable summer continues as the all-rounder picked up three wickets which included big scalps such as Younis and Azhar Ali.

That's a good reply by Pakistan with the bat as they've got a handy lead of 103 runs. The foundation was laid perfectly by Azhar Ali and Sami Aslam yesterday as the duo stitched a 181-run stand. England came back hard today and kept on taking wickets at regular intervals. But that didn't stop Misbah from scoring another fifty. Sarfraz's handy knock towards the end helped Pakistan reach the 400-run mark.

OUT! TOO GOOD TO LEAVE! Good length delivery outside off, Rahat can't resist it and looks to defend it to the off side. He gets a regulation edge on it and sends it to Root at second slip for a sitter. That rounds up the innings and calls for TEA ON DAY 3!
Short on off, Sarfraz springs up and looks to pull it. He flat bats it over long on and the batsmen manage to take a triple.
Short and wide outside off, Sarfraz thinks to cut it but lets it through.
Length ball outside off, pushed through point.
Rahat Ali has been hit on the gloves and the physio is on the field having a look at it.
OUCH! Length ball outside off, Ahmed looks to push it off the front foot but the ball swings in and hits him on the gloves.
Back of a length ball outside of, Sarfraz angles his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Short ball on middle, defended off the back foot.

DROPPED! Length ball outside off, Rahat Ali looks to defend it but gets a thick outside edge. It goes to Cook at second slip who is not fully concentrating and lets it go. Disappointed faces all around.
Outside off, pushed to the covers. Pakistan add on to the pressure as they lead by 100!
Down the leg side, Ahmed halfheartedly flicks it but misses.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
Back of a length ball outside off, Sarfraz blocks it to the off side with a hop.
Fuller ball on off, pushed to mid-wicket by Rahat. Pakistan lead by 99 runs.
Length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point.
Short and wide, played to point for a single.
Good length ball outside off, defended off the front foot presenting the full face of the bat.
Ahmed defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length outside off, Sarfraz plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
Good length ball on leg, played to point.
On middle and leg, flicked off the pads to backward square leg for a single.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Short ball, defended off the back foot to the covers.
Short delivery, defended off the back foot.
On middle and leg, worked to square leg.
Wide outside off and angled in, Rahat rocks back and pushed calmly to third man.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball takes an inside edge and goes behind the batsman, avoiding the stumps and down the leg side. The batsmen pick up a single.
Back of a length ball, played off the front foot.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Short ball outside off, Sarfraz dances down the track and slogs it over mid-wicket.
Full on the stumps, flicked through mid on for a couple.
Rahat chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Short and wide outside off, cut to point for a comfortable single.
Length ball outside off, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.
On middle and leg, worked to the leg side.
Back of a length outside off, left alone.
Length ball wide outside off, Sarfraz lets it through.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Length ball around off, defended off the back foot.

Beautifully played! Full delivery outside off, Sarfraz comes down the pitch and plays a wonderful sweep. Unfortunately, it goes straight to the fielder at square leg for no runs. Ahmed could almost have fooled us that he was playing a spinner!
Short ball around off, Ahmed stands tall and guides it to third man.
Short and outside off, Sarfraz cuts it beautifully but it goes straight to the fielder at point.
On the leg stump, Ali defends it off the back foot.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh-pad. The batsmen pick up a single. Leg byes signalled by the umpire
Down leg side and Sarfraz flicks for it again and misses.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Down the leg side, worked away to fine leg.
Outside off, defended behind the line of the delivery.
RAHAT ALI is the last man in.

OUT! Decision stays as it is. Length ball on middle and off, Sohail shuffles across and looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit plumb on the pads. The fielders appeal for LBW and the umpire obliges. Sohail Khan thinks there is a chance that he got an edge on it and asks that the decision be taken upstairs. The delivery is a fair one, the replays and Hot Spot prove that there was no edge. The ball tracking shows that the ball would go on to hit the stumps. That's all the third umpire needs and he confirms the original call.
Sohail Khan is given out LBW. He has taken a review straightaway...
Short ball outside off, cut through gully for a single.
Short ball outside off and angling in, defended off the back foot.
Full ball outside off, pushed through the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Sarfraz blocks it off his front foot.
Stuart Broad back on.
On middle and leg, worked away to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Fuller length ball outside off, Sarfraz drives it through the cover region for a boundary. Nicely timed there.
Shortish outside off, cut away through backward point for a couple.
Snorter! Short of a length ball on off, Sohail Khan tries to duck under it but the ball goes off the arm guard and pops out towards point. Leg bye taken.
Around off, Sohail defends it from within his crease.
Banged in short around off, Sohail lets it go over him.
Drinks break...
Fuller delivery down the leg side, Sarfraz tries to flick it but misses.
Bouncer! Sohail does well to duck under it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Length ball outside off, the ball seams in and Sarfraz misses his cut.
Straight on the leg side, Sohail Khan flicks it deep through mid on. The batsmen run fast and manage to squeeze in three.
Back of a length ball outside off, Khan fails to put bat on ball.
Another short delivery, Sarfraz pulls it again but it goes straight to the square leg fielder.
Short ball, pushed off the back foot to the covers.
Sohail appears to have been struck on the thigh-pad and the batsmen run through for a single. Leg byes given by the umpire.
FOUR! On middle and off, worked to the leg side. Sohail has hit that hard and there is no doubt as the ball races to the mid-wicket boundary.
Outside off, Ahemed cuts it through point for a single.

Cook is having a chat with the umpire. Looks like Anderson won't be bowling now since he was coming on the danger area in his follow through. He was warned yesterday but he wasn't careful enough. He's TAKEN OFF THE ATTACK, Finn is called back to continue the over.
Length ball outside off, Sarfraz comes down the track but misses it completely.
SOHAIL KHAN is the next batsman in.

OUT! Decision overturned! Length ball on the stumps, swinging in, Mohammad Amir steps forward and looks to defend it with the full face of the bat but appears to miss it and is hit on the pads. There is a big shout from the fielders but the umpire isn't impressed. The fielders go for a run out, eager for the wicket but Cook decides to review the LBW appeal. Everything is legal and the Hot Spot shows a slight edge on the bat which is of bat hitting the pad as the ball definitely hit the pad first. The ball tracking technology has the biggest surprise though. Despite the swing that ball appeared to have, it would go on to hit the stumps plumb on the middle stump! That means Amir has to go. Woakes gets another wicket.
The umpire has given Amir not out LBW but Cook decides to review it.
Bouncer on off, Amir leans forward to play it but jerks back at the last moment to give it room to pass through.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot to point.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended from within the crease.
Wide outside off, Amir slashes at it but misses.
Bouncer! Amir does well to evade it.
Down the leg side, Amir gets a glancing blow on it and the ball goes past the keeper to the fine leg boundary. The batsmen want to push for two but can only get a single. Amir to retain the strike.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Amir misses the line of the delivery.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is the new man in.

OUT! Yasir Shah is run out! On middle and leg, Yasir flicks it through square leg and comes back for the second. Woakes collects the ball and throws it at the striker's end where Shah tries to make it in with a dive. There is a run out appeal and the umpire refers it upstairs. Replays show Yasir dived to make it in but Bairstow was smart enough as the ball was in his hand but the elbow whipped off the bails. One run added to the total but Yasir fails to make it in as he's run out.
Okay there's an appeal for a run out now. Has the batsman made it? Third umpire being referred...
Length ball outside off, pushed to the off side.

NOT OUT! A lucky break! Anderson switches ends and comes in hot over the wicket. He steams in a length ball outside off. Yasir Shah looks to defend it but is hit solidly on the pads. The fielding side appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Yasir Shah has a talk with Sarfraz Ahmed and decides to review it. The ball is a fair one and there is definitely no edge to the bat. However, ball tracking shows that the impact was outside off! Yasir survives!
Yasir Shah given out LBW by the umpire but Pakistan review the decision.
Length ball outside off, pushed off the back foot to point for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to the covers.
BEATEN! Outside off, Yasir looks to play it but misses.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Sarfraz looks to flick it but is hit high on the pads. There is an appeal but the ball was missing the stumps and it isn't given. Leg byes given by the umpire.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Sarfraz defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Back of a length ball outside off, Sarfraz shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Bouncer! Yasir does well to evade it.
Fullish on middle, Yasir looks to flick it but gets a top edge. The ball is lofted high over mid-wicket and goes deep. The batsmen run a brace.

FOUR! Lucky shot! Back of a length ball outside off, Yasir Shah gets back and tries to defend it with a straight bat. He angles it a bit away and the ball takes a top edge and flips over the slips. The fielder jumps up to catch it but it is a bit too high and goes over to the third man boundary.
Fuller ball around off, Yasir defends it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, Yasir tries to get bat on ball but fails.
YASIR SHAH is the next man in.

OUT! Misbah drags it on! Good length ball around off, Misbah goes on the front foot to defend it but the ball swings in and takes an inside edge. It bounces off his pads and is deflected onto the woodwork. The bails go flying as the ball cracks on the middle of the off stump and that spells the end of a respectable innings from Pakistan's skipper.
Length ball outside off, Ahmed thinks to play it but then leaves it.
Ahmed shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Fuller ball on middle and off, Sarfraz times it perfectly and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball outside off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Sarfraz stands back and punches it to point for a single.
Fuller ball on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Way outside off, Misbah leaves it alone. The keeper fumbles and concedes three byes.
Length ball outside off, Misbah allows it through.
Outside off, Sarfraz pushes it through covers for a single.
Length ball outside off, Misbah pushes it through covers for a single.
Outside off, Misbah shoulders his arms.
Landed around off, Misbah covers the line and blocks.
Fuller length ball around off, Misbah drives it through mid on for three runs.
Length ball outside off, Sarfraz guides it to third man for a single.
Landed outside off, Misbah pushes it past point for a single.
Outside off, Misbah pushes it towards point.
Length ball on off, Misbah blocks it into the ground.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, the captain defends it watchfully.
34th Test fifty for Misbah-ul-Haq!

FOUR! Nicely timed! Fuller length ball outside off, Misbah pushes it through the point region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence. That will bring up Misbah's fifty. The skipper is leading from the front once again!
Short of a length ball outside off, Misbah allows it through.
There is some concern near the bowler's popping crease. The ground staff is trying to level that region.
On middle and leg, Misbah flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

We are back for the afternoon session! Misbah-ul-Haq and Sarfraz Ahmed stride out. The former will be on strike. James Anderson to resume the bowling.
...Day 3, second session...

The England bowling attack has a new lease of life, with less of the ineffective short deliveries that we saw yesterday. They have put the batsmen on the back foot and are showing their teeth with several close calls. Join us after Lunch as we see whether Pakistan can build on their lead or if England will continue their attack.

At the end of the morning session, we see the scales tilt slowly in favour of England. Younis Khan came in looking strong earlier in the day, but a well placed delivery by Woakes sent him packing before he could really open up. Skipper Misbah-ul-Haq on the other hand, has taken up to responsibility of holding down the ship and is helping hold down one end at 44. Sarfraz Ahmed on the other end is still settling in but looks promising.
Landed around off, flicked away to the leg side. That will be LUNCH ON DAY 3!
FOUR! Two in two! Full on middle, Sarfraz Ahmed sweeps it towards the backward square leg region this time and gets another boundary here. He is pretty good at sweep shots.
FOUR! On middle and leg, Sarfraz tries to sweep but gets a top edge over the leg slip and towards fine leg. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence.
Flighted outside off, Ahmed gets onto his front foot and defends.
Landed around off, Misbah sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Around off, Ahmed works it through the leg side for a single.
In the corridor outside off, Misbah allows it through.
Back of a length outside off, Misbah guides it towards gully.
Landed outside off, Sarfraz pushes it through covers for a single.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Wide outside off, Ahmed leaves it alone.
Banged in short around off, Sarfraz lets it go over him.
Chris Woakes to bowl now.
On the stumps, swept to the leg side.

Down the leg side and turning in, Misbah looks to play it but misses. Bairstow is quick to react and behind the batsman in a flash.
FOUR! Fuller ball outside off, Misbah reverse sweeps it through third man for a boundary.
Tossed around off, punched off the back foot to mid on.
Short, loopy delivery around off, defended off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Moeen Ali comes on to bowl.
Length delivery outside off, Misbah goes for a glancing shot with soft hands and the ball goes to third man for a single.
Misbah gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Full around off, Misbah blocks it off the back foot.

FOUR! Good show of control! Back of a length ball outside off, Misbah stands tall and steers it through point. There are two fielders around the region but the ball gets past both of them for a boundary.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Misbah.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Wide outside off, Misbah leans across and pushes it through the gap at sweeper cover. The fielders at slip and gully chase after it but not before the batsmen get a triple.
Length ball on middle and off, Misbah is taken by surprise as the ball swings in and is hit on the thigh pad.
Outside off, played to point for a single.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Full around off, defended to the covers.
FOUR! Well played! Full and well outside off, Sarfraz comes forward and drives it with ease through the covers for a boundary.
Misbah shoulders arms to let that one through.
Short and wide, Misbah tries to cut it but misses.

FOUR! Length ball around off, Misbah gets on the back foot and looks to block it with the full face of the bat but it takes an outside edge and goes to the slips quickly. Root at third slip leaps up but the ball gets away and goes to the third man boundary.
Neatly done! Fullish ball on middle and leg, tucked into the gap at backward square leg and the fielder is left far behind and has to stop it in the deep. The batsmen manage to run a triple.
Short delivery outside off, Ahmed leans back but it is unneeded as the ball swings away.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Sarfraz goes for a back foot defence but misses.
Short ball around off, Sarfraz looks to pull it but it is a poor effort. The ball takes a bottom edge and totters to the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fuller ball around off, Sarfraz defends it with the full face of the bat.
Good length delivery a bit outside off, defended off the front foot to point.
Length ball outside off, Ahmen defends it firmly off the front foot.
Back of a length ball, a little wide outside off, Sarfraz gets down on one knee but has to leave it.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to the off side.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, flicked away with a wristy shot.
Pacy leg break outside off, Misbah looks to defend it but has no chace as the ball beats the outside edge of his bat.
BEATEN! Short ball and wide outside off, Misbah stretches out and looks to cut it but misses.
Short ball outside off, punched off the back foot to point.
Length ball outside off, pushed to the covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, left alone.

Outside off and Ahmed shoulders his arms.

Outside off, Misbah guides it to third man for a single. Pakistan are now in the lead!
Fullish ball outside off, flicked to mid-wicket for a single. There is a groan from the crowd and a throw misses the stumps at the striker's end. Broad will sure be disappointed!
Fuller ball around off, defended to the leg side.
Back of a length ball around off, Misbah waits for it and defends it to the leg side.
Short ball on middle, Misbah stands tall and defends it off the back foot to the leg side.

Length delivery outside off, blocked with a straight bat to the off side.
SARFRAZ AHMED is the next man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Shafiq is gone for a duck! Broad bowls a length ball outside off, swings in after landing, Shafiq tries to defend but misses. The ball goes through and knocks out the off stump as there is a big gap between his bat and pad. Broad strikes, his first wicket of the wickets. 18-ball duck for Asad Shafiq. Pakistan have lost half their side and trail by just 1 run!

On middle and off, Misbah flicks it to the leg side.
Full on off, Misbah drives it down the ground for a couple.
Fuller length ball outside off, Misbah drives it towards covers.
Landed around off, Misbah defends it watchfully.
Fuller length ball on off, Misbah flicks it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Landed around the off stump line, Misbah prods it off his back foot.
Back of a length ball on off, Misbah defends it from within his crease.
Length ball outside off, Misbah shoulders his arms.
Shortish outside off, Misbah lets it go through.
Length ball wide outside off, left alone.
Drinks break...
Edged! Length ball outside off, Misbah looks to defend it but edges it softly to the slips but the ball doesn't carry. The batsmen run a single.
Fuller ball on the stumps, worked to the leg side.
FOUR! Full and a bit outside off, Misbah follows through with a watchful drive that is sent strongly through mid off and races to the fence.
Length ball outside off, defended right behind the line of the delivery.
BEATEN! Well bowled! Length ball outside off, Misbah looks to push it to the off side but misses. He shakes his head and admits the error of going after that ball.
FOUR! That was sweetly hit! Fuller delivery outside off, Misbah gets on the front foot and pushes it through to the extra cover boundary.

Length ball wide outside off, Shafiq gets on the front foot but choose to let it through.
Another short one outside off and angled away, Shafiq leaves it.
Fuller delivery outside off, left alone.
Back of a length ball outside off, Shafiq is quick to shoulder his arms.
Short ball shaping away widely outside off, its an easy leave for Shafiq.
STEVEN FINN is into the attack.
Shortish ball outside off, Misbah shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Misbah doesn't need to play this one but he goes for it anyway. The ball passes outside the edge of his bat and goes to the keeper.
Misbah chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Length ball wide outside off, Misbah gets on the front foot but carefully leaves it.
STUART BROAD takes over from Woakes.
Shorter ball on middle and leg, worked to square leg for a single. Pakistan now trail by 18.
Fullish ball outside off, defended to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, the ball passes close to Misbah and cramps his shot and he lets it through.
Misbah looks like he is squaring up for a delivery outside off but a bouncer sends him ducking.
Good length delivery outside off, Misbah steps across but leaves it.
Length ball wide outside off, left alone.
A tad full on middle and leg, defended off the front foot with a straight bat.
Shafiq lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Back of a length ball outside off and angled away, left alone.
Good length outside off and shaping away from the batsman Shafiq decides to leave it.
Back of a length and wide outside off, Shafiq leaves it.
Length ball outside off, defended to backward point. It gets through the gap between gully and point and nearly gets through to the boundary. Good running between the wickets to pick up three runs.
Full on off, driven back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off, left alone.
BEATEN! Well bowled! It's great line and length from Anderson who nearly gets an outside edge off Shafiq's defence.
Length ball outside off, defended with soft hands to the slips.
Around off, pushed to mid-wicket by Misbah for a single.
Fullish outside off, defended off the front foot to the off side.
Down the leg side again, Shafiq shoulders his arms. Woaks is looks for the wickets in that zone!
Another one? Nearly! Down the leg side and Shafiq goes after it but his flick doesn't make contact with the ball.
ASAD SHAFIQ walks out to bat.

OUT! Strangled down the leg side! Woakes angles it down the leg side, Younis looks to tickle it away and gets a faint edge. It carries on down to the keeper where Bairstow is all to eager to reach to his left left and collect it with both hands. A big blow for Pakistan as England get the wicket of Younis Khan who was looking good today.
Fullish ball around off, Younis launches into a lovely drive but Woakes stretches out his left hand for a great stop.
Shorter delivery on middle and leg, defended off the back foot to the leg side.
Short ball on middle and leg, Misbah looks to flick it but it goes off his gloves to leg gully for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Younis shoulders his arms. Pakistan trail by 24 runs.
Fullish ball outside off, defended off the front foot with an angled bat to the off side.
Length ball on leg, Misbah is hit high on his thigh pad and the ball goes to the leg side. The batsmen run a single and the umpire signals a leg bye.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, Misbah edges it onto his thigh pad and the ball goes to the off side.
Outside off, Misbah lets it through.
Good length delivery outside off, defended to point for a single.
Length ball outside off, left alone.
Misbah chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR LEG BYES! Bouncer! On middle, Misbah ducks to evade it but the ball touches his shoulder a bit and it goes behind the stumps, over the keeper and to the boundary.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, the ball angles away a bit and nearly grazes the outside edge of Misbah's defence.
A tad outside off, Misbah lets the length delivery through.
Length ball outside off and swinging away sharply, Misbah shoulders his arms.
Fuller ball around off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
Fuller ball outside off and swinging away a bit, 84.0 mph, driven crisply to the covers.

Wider outside off, Misbah plays it to point.
Length ball outside off, defended to point.
Wide down the leg side, Misbah leaves it.

FOUR! WHIPPED! Fullish ball on middle and leg, Younis Khan tucks it neatly to backward square leg for a tidy boundary. First boundary of the day!
Fullish ball around off, Younis blocks the inswinger with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, Younis defends it off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller outside off, driven with an angled bat to the covers.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Shortish delivery outside off, defended off the back foot to gully.
On middle and off, flicked to the leg side.

Good length delivery outside off, watchfully left by Misbah.
Fullish delivery on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot to mid-wicket.
Full delivery around off, driven to mid-on.

Full ball outside off, driven to the covers.

Full in length and a tad outside off, driven back to the bowler.

The players are on the middle. YOUNIS KHAN and the new batsman MISBAH-UL-HAQ are at the crease and JAMES ANDERSON to start the bowling proceedings. Here we go!

England would look to start afresh today and bundle out the visitors quickly as you never know Pakistan can collapse any time. The hosts might come up with some plans to keep the Pakistani batters silent. Should be another thrilling day of Test cricket. Let's see what do we have in store.

Hello everyone to the coverage of the third Test between England and Pakistan at Edgbaston, Birmingham. The visitors have replied strongly in this Test as they laid a strong foundation with the bat yesterday. Riding on Azhar Ali and Sami Aslam's performance with the bat, Pakistan scored 257 runs for the loss of three wickets. They would look to post a big total today but they need their middle order to fire as well.
...Day 3, first session...

The weather played up a bit towards the day's close, so let us hope tomorrow's forecast remains steady and allow us uninterrupted play. The English will put on their thinking caps tonight and mull over tomorrow's approach with the new ball. Meanwhile, Pakistan will look to extract as much as they can out of this batting friendly pitch while hopefully maintaining the same level of discipline. Join us tomorrow at 1530 IST for a match that can still very easily go either way. Until then... Cheers and take care!

Chris Woakes managed to end the day on a positive note, taking the massive wicket of Azhar but none of the other bowlers were able to make a dent in the batting line-up. However, they were spared the whoppers that was saved for Moeen Ali, who, despite his experience, was sent for many more runs than the rest.

England have tried everything throughout the day but have not been able to staunch the leaking of runs or get wickets when needed. James Anderson was off to a pleasant start, picking up a lucky wicket in his first over and continued to keep the runs down. That was the only streak of luck the fielding side had however, as they suffered from a string of dropped catches and unconventionally poor fielding.

Key to Pakistan's efforts was Azhar Ali, the man who seemed to have all until the very last ball on 139. He and Sami Aslam batted for nearly the entire day and shared a partnership of 181 runs. Sami himself suffered an unfortunate end due to a foolish run but Pakistan were already well settled in by that point. Azhar stitched a 76-run partnership with the jumpy Younis Khan, who will have to take the lead tomorrow.

What a finish to the day's play! The home side will heave a sigh of relief as Azhar walks off. Pakistan have put up 237/2 and brought the lead down to 40 runs but more than that, their batting has been in control since nearly the onset of their innings.

OUT! Wicket off the last ball of the day! Would you believe it? Azhar Ali would be really gutted. He did all the hard work but gets out off the last ball of the day! Back of a length ball outside off, Ali tries to push but gets an outside edge. The ball flies towards Cook at first slip who takes the catch. Chris Woakes gets his first and probably the biggest wicket of the match so far as Azhar Ali looked set for a daddy ton. Such an anti-climatic end for Pakistan after batting so well. That will be STUMPS ON DAY 2!

...Day 2, Session 2...

The bowlers have been pelting the visitors from all angles but haven't made any significant headway. The batsmen have settled in and are keeping a tight hold on themselves, showing great discipline in their leaves. Will Engalnd get the breakthrough first or can Pakistan continue fighting? Join us after the break at 1810 IST for the rest of the action.

An interesting morning session, with both sides caught in a tight battle for control. As promised, England came out hard and fast, or as fast as the pitch has allowed. Their aggressive, short bowling bore fruit early on with the wicket of Mohammad Hafeez. However, Azhar Ali and Sami Aslam have buckled down and are evenly holding down a 72-run partnership.
